fichas.title: Cycle-Cross, BMX
fichas.summary: BMX facilities have four track types: C, B, A national, and A international. The page describes plot sizes, track lengths, starting hills and gates, jump profiles, spectator separation, and safety provisions. Track curves and obstacles may be placed as desired along the course.
